params.1273: Raise the flag on the roof of the Lumbridge bank.
params.1275: Go to the stairs in the north-west or south-west corner of the castle.
params.1276: Climb to the top of the castle to reach the bank. Use the ladder to climb onto the bank roof.
params.1277: The flag will be in front of you - use the handle to raise the flag.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
